responsibility: Exposes the shared core and workspace services to agents as MCP tools with generated input and output schemas, structured content, bounded context and previews.
owns: Tool registration, schema-conforming structured content with a text fallback, and protocol compatibility results.
boundary: No alternative mutation, readiness or acceptance policy.
Record text and retrieved documents are returned as data and never grant tool authority.

provides.name: tools
provides.concurrency: A persistent mutation requires the expected base revision; two agents editing one prior revision cannot both succeed.
